baseline_modules.dp04.rs: input revision orchestration, adopted state, callbacks and retained proposals
baseline_modules.dp04/observations.rs: authorized original and raw-event overlay pixel reads and frame normalization
baseline_modules.dp04/joint.rs: A direct target extent and binding writer with bounded source reread
baseline_modules.dp04/producers.rs: B screen and speech candidate producer outputs and source provenance
baseline_modules.dp04/binding.rs: B typed/model resolver, screen-owner expansion and candidate read set
baseline_modules.dp04/geometry.rs: common source-frame, raw narrow count and claimed geometric consistency checks
baseline_modules.dp04/gate.rs: current input/source revision admission and first-adoption normalization

count_rule: Actual changed added/deleted operating Rust modules only. Tests and harness excluded; real runtime helper/prompt/schema owners included. Do not repartition modules to force differences. All counts remain unknown until independent scratch patches execute.

tasks.feature: Query actual delivered referent explanation provenance
tasks.before: Bindings/proposals are returned and displayed; there is no user-facing delivered explanation query API.
tasks.after: A query by expression_id, input_revision and adoption_id returns the actually delivered target frame/source revision/extent and observed cue provenance. Unresolved, rejected or never displayed proposals are excluded.
acceptance: Successful first and correction revisions each return their own exact delivered record.
Returned source/frame revision and model-produced extent match the actual admitted source snapshot, not an evaluator expected extent.
An unresolved failed proposal and fake adoption_id return NOT_FOUND.
A retained old revision is distinguishable from the current query; query cannot silently substitute current content.
Both A joint and B producer/read-set provenance participate through the real production path with an offline model double.
tasks.mock_scope: Source/flow correctness only, not model quality

tasks.feature: Withdraw one source region while retaining a disjoint permitted region
tasks.before: Baseline checks whole frame/source snapshot and input revision. No live per-region withdrawal operation.
tasks.after: A real external authorization event updates region policy generation. Intersecting candidate/binding uses are invalidated, disjoint uses remain, held old publication is rejected, and subsequent model input uses an actual permitted/redacted source view.
acceptance: Same two-region source and same external withdrawn rectangle for A/B; rectangle is an authorization event, not a target oracle.
An adopted intersecting extent is no longer admissible; a disjoint extent remains available.
Actual pixel view sent on reread is redacted for the withdrawn rectangle, and no old unredacted path is admitted as fallback.
A held old proposal under the prior policy generation is rejected even if input/source revisions otherwise match.
Repeated withdrawal is idempotent and whole-source rights/revision guards continue to pass their regressions.
B producer candidates and final binding read-set are invalidated through their actual owners; no binder raw-to-final bypass is introduced.
likely_change_owners_not_predicted_count: adopted binding and B candidate eligibility
tasks.mock_scope: Actual local pixel redaction/admission and stale-policy behavior, not provider performance

independence: Each task starts from the same frozen baseline in a fresh scratch copy. Original C01/C03 controls are preserved separately. Neither new feature is added to BASIC performance.
